plugins.manifest:
# tv.maktaba.classify: Maktaba's classifiers as a first-party plugin (Epic 54, README §15.2).
# Wave 1 (story 54.28) moves the stages that read the database and write it, with no file,
# no model and no network; wave 4 (story 54.31) brings the rest of classify.
schema     = 1
id         = "tv.maktaba.classify"
version    = "0.0.0-dev"
plugin_api = "1.0"
maktaba    = ">=0.0.0"
licence    = "AGPL-3.0-only"
runtime    = "native-python"

[strings]
name    = "fp.classify.name"
summary = "fp.classify.summary"

[trusted]
runner    = "light"
component = "classify"
db.read   = ["app_settings", "libraries", "media_metadata_enrichment", "processing_jobs", "series", "series_episodes", "series_seasons", "video_signals", "video_topic_tags", "videos", "youtube_playlist_items", "youtube_playlists", "youtube_videos"]
db.write  = ["clip_group_items", "clip_groups", "promo_links", "season_style", "topic_collections", "topic_items"]
settings  = ["groups", "detect"]

[[stage]]
name         = "promo_links"
subject      = "library"
export       = "promo-links"
version      = 1
label        = "Promo links"
subject_kinds = ["library"]
pool         = "cpu"
lane         = "seasons"
lane_order   = 2
entry_for    = ["library"]
debounce_sec = 30
debounce_max_sec = 300
edges        = [{ to = "clip_groups", map = "same" }, { to = "plan_channels", map = "catalog" }]
entry        = "maktaba_fp_classify.stages.promo_links:IMPL"
fingerprint  = { input = true, output = false }

[[stage]]
name         = "clip_groups"
subject      = "library"
export       = "clip-groups"
version      = 1
label        = "Clip groups"
subject_kinds = ["library"]
pool         = "cpu"
lane         = "seasons"
lane_order   = 3
entry_for    = ["library"]
debounce_sec = 30
debounce_max_sec = 300
edges        = [{ to = "plan_channels", map = "catalog" }]
entry        = "maktaba_fp_classify.stages.clip_groups:IMPL"
fingerprint  = { input = true, output = false }

[[stage]]
name         = "topic_collections"
subject      = "library"
export       = "topic-collections"
version      = 1
label        = "Topic collections"
subject_kinds = ["library"]
pool         = "cpu"
lane         = "seasons"
lane_order   = 2
entry_for    = ["library"]
debounce_sec = 30
debounce_max_sec = 300
edges        = [{ to = "clip_groups", map = "same" }, { to = "plan_channels", map = "catalog" }, { to = "youtube_collections", map = "same" }]
entry        = "maktaba_fp_classify.stages.topic_collections:IMPL"
fingerprint  = { input = true, output = false }

[[stage]]
name         = "rate_style"
subject      = "season"
export       = "rate-style"
version      = 1
label        = "Rate style"
subject_kinds = ["season"]
pool         = "cpu"
lane         = "seasons"
lane_order   = 3
may_request  = ["style_sample"]
entry_for    = ["season"]
debounce_sec = 10
debounce_max_sec = 120
edges        = [{ to = "plan_channels", map = "catalog" }]
entry        = "maktaba_fp_classify.stages.rate_style:IMPL"
fingerprint  = { input = true, output = false }

statements.name: clip_groups.input_fingerprint
statements.text: SELECT id, membership_hash FROM series_seasons WHERE library_id = $1 AND retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

statements.name: clip_groups.input_fingerprint.2
statements.text: SELECT id, size_bytes, mtime FROM videos WHERE library_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

statements.name: clip_groups.input_fingerprint.3
statements.text: SELECT t.video_id AS v, t.tag AS t, t.score AS s FROM video_topic_tags t JOIN videos v ON v.id = t.video_id WHERE v.library_id = $1 ORDER BY 1, 2

statements.name: clip_groups.input_fingerprint.4
statements.text: SELECT playlist_id FROM topic_collections WHERE library_id = $1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: clip_groups.input_fingerprint.5
statements.text: SELECT video_id FROM promo_links WHERE library_id = $1 ORDER BY 1

statements.name: clip_groups.plan_library_groups
statements.text: SELECT playlist_id FROM topic_collections WHERE library_id = $1

statements.name: clip_groups.plan_library_groups.2
statements.text: SELECT video_id FROM promo_links WHERE library_id = $1

statements.name: clip_groups.run
statements.text: DELETE FROM clip_groups WHERE library_id = $1

statements.name: clip_groups.run.2
statements.text: INSERT INTO clip_groups (id, library_id, kind, basis, name, topic, title, membership_hash, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)

statements.name: clip_groups.run.3
statements.text: INSERT INTO clip_group_items (group_id, video_id, position) VALUES ($1,$2,$3)

statements.name: common.load_season
statements.text: SELECT id, series_id, library_id, name, kind, season, membership_hash, retired_at, median_duration_s, metadata FROM series_seasons WHERE id = $1

statements.name: common.season_episode_ids
statements.text: SELECT e.video_id AS id FROM series_episodes e JOIN series_seasons ss ON ss.series_id = e.series_id  AND ss.season = COALESCE(e.season_override, e.season) WHERE ss.id = $1 ORDER BY COALESCE(e.episode_override, e.episode), e.video_id

statements.name: detect.playlists
statements.text: SELECT p.playlist_id AS pid, p.title AS title, m.video_id AS vid, i.position AS pos FROM youtube_playlists p JOIN youtube_playlist_items i ON i.playlist_id = p.playlist_id JOIN media_metadata_enrichment m ON m.external_id = i.youtube_id AND m.provider = 'youtube' JOIN videos v ON v.id = m.video_id WHERE p.is_real = $2 AND v.library_id = $1 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.playlist_id, i.position

statements.name: leftovers.library_name
statements.text: SELECT name FROM libraries WHERE id = $1

statements.name: leftovers.load_leftovers
statements.text: SELECT ss.id AS id, ss.series_id AS series_id, ss.season AS season, ss.kind AS kind, ss.metadata AS metadata FROM series_seasons ss WHERE ss.library_id = $1 AND ss.retired_at IS NULL

statements.name: leftovers.load_leftovers.2
statements.text: SELECT e.video_id AS vid, ss.kind AS kind FROM series_episodes e JOIN series_seasons ss ON ss.series_id = e.series_id  AND ss.season = COALESCE(e.season_override, e.season) AND ss.retired_at IS NULL WHERE ss.library_id = $1

statements.name: leftovers.load_leftovers.3
statements.text: SELECT t.video_id AS vid, t.tag AS tag, t.score AS score FROM video_topic_tags t JOIN videos v ON v.id = t.video_id WHERE v.library_id = $1

statements.name: leftovers.load_leftovers.4
statements.text:
SELECT v.id AS vid, COALESCE(yv.title, v.title, v.filename) AS title,
       COALESCE(v.duration_sec, yv.duration_s) AS dur, yv.upload_date AS upload_date,
       yv.tab AS tab, v.metadata AS metadata
  FROM videos v
  LEFT JOIN media_metadata_enrichment m ON m.video_id = v.id AND m.provider = 'youtube'
  LEFT JOIN youtube_videos yv ON yv.youtube_id = m.external_id
 WHERE v.library_id = $1 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
 ORDER BY v.id

statements.name: leftovers.load_shows
statements.text: SELECT s.id AS id, COALESCE(s.name_override, s.name) AS name, s.library_id AS lib, COALESCE(l.name, '') AS library, ss.season AS season FROM series s JOIN series_seasons ss ON ss.series_id = s.id AND ss.retired_at IS NULL AND ss.kind <> 'clips' LEFT JOIN libraries l ON l.id = s.library_id ORDER BY s.id, ss.season

statements.name: promo_links.input_fingerprint
statements.text: SELECT id, membership_hash FROM series_seasons WHERE retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

statements.name: promo_links.run
statements.text: SELECT id, series_id, season FROM series_seasons WHERE retired_at IS NULL

statements.name: promo_links.run.2
statements.text: DELETE FROM promo_links WHERE library_id = $1

statements.name: promo_links.run.3
statements.text: INSERT INTO promo_links (video_id, library_id, series_id, season_id, season, score, evidence, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)

statements.name: rate_style.gave_up
statements.text: SELECT state, attempts, max_attempts FROM processing_jobs WHERE subject_kind = 'video' AND subject_id = $1 AND stage = 'style_sample' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

statements.name: rate_style.input_fingerprint
statements.text: SELECT output_hash FROM processing_jobs WHERE subject_kind = 'video' AND subject_id = $1 AND stage = 'style_sample' AND state = 'done' AND outcome IN ('changed','unchanged','skipped_unchanged','imported') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

statements.name: rate_style.metrics
statements.text: SELECT style_metrics, style_version FROM video_signals WHERE video_id = $1

statements.name: rate_style.override
statements.text: SELECT override_style FROM season_style WHERE season_id = $1

statements.name: rate_style.run
statements.text: SELECT style, tier, confidence FROM season_style WHERE season_id = $1

statements.name: rate_style.write
statements.text: INSERT INTO season_style (season_id, style, tier, confidence, reasons, sampled, style_version, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT (season_id) DO UPDATE SET style = EXCLUDED.style, tier = EXCLUDED.tier, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, reasons = EXCLUDED.reasons, sampled = EXCLUDED.sampled, style_version = EXCLUDED.style_version, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

statements.name: rules.read
statements.text: SELECT value FROM app_settings WHERE key = $1

statements.name: topic_collections.plan_topics
statements.text: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE library_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

statements.name: topic_collections.run
statements.text: DELETE FROM topic_collections WHERE library_id = $1

statements.name: topic_collections.run.2
statements.text: INSERT INTO topic_collections (id, library_id, playlist_id, name, membership_hash, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)

statements.name: topic_collections.run.3
statements.text: INSERT INTO topic_items (topic_id, video_id, position) VALUES ($1,$2,$3)

statements.name: topic_collections.stored_series
statements.text: SELECT ss.id AS id, ss.series_id AS series_id, ss.season AS season, ss.kind AS kind, ss.name AS name, ss.metadata AS metadata FROM series_seasons ss WHERE ss.library_id = $1 AND ss.retired_at IS NULL ORDER BY ss.series_id, ss.season

statements.name: topic_collections.stored_series.2
statements.text: SELECT e.series_id AS series_id, COALESCE(e.season_override, e.season) AS season, e.video_id AS vid FROM series_episodes e JOIN series s ON s.id = e.series_id WHERE s.library_id = $1 ORDER BY e.series_id, COALESCE(e.season_override, e.season), COALESCE(e.episode_override, e.episode), e.video_id

ar.fp.classify.name: التصنيف
ar.fp.classify.summary: يجد مواضيع كل مكتبة وإعلاناتها ومجموعات مقاطعها، ويقدّر أسلوب كل موسم.

en.fp.classify.name: Classify
en.fp.classify.summary: Finds the topics, promos and clip groups of each library, and rates each season's style.
